value: Residential Tenancy Law (Dzīvojamo telpu īres likums).
note: English translation on likumi.lv; the Latvian text prevails.

value: The lessor may request a security deposit not exceeding two months of rent; unused deposit is returned no later than the day the dwelling is vacated unless the agreement provides otherwise (Section 12).
note: English translation on likumi.lv; the Latvian text prevails.

value: Rent is set by written agreement and may be modified during the agreement only if the agreement provides the conditions and procedures for modification (Section 10).
note: English translation on likumi.lv; the Latvian text prevails.

value: The lessor may terminate for rent arrears exceeding two months of rent, or other payments delayed two months, unless the agreement sets higher limits (Section 24), and for the other statutory grounds in the law.
note: English translation on likumi.lv; the Latvian text prevails.

value: Tenant: at least one month written notice for agreements up to 10 years. Lessor: at least one month for arrears or unauthorised occupancy and for demolition or reconstruction where the agreement is up to one year; at least three months where the agreement is one to three years (Section 27).
note: English translation on likumi.lv; the Latvian text prevails.
